munir: can you paste the exact command and a tiny repro?

./bin/eval --model=models/zephyr-lite:q6 --suite=multiorient_smoke --input=tests/cjk_ar_sample.json

Observed output: （مرحبا 636261）歌詞
sofia: metrics: fp16 baseline BLEU 27.8 -> zephyr-q6 18.4 on the mini-suite. chrF -6.1. token mismatches +41/160, concentrated where RTL is inside fullwidth CJK punctuation.
eval-bot: auto-ticket created id=ml-3723456789-f; model_sha=1a2b3c; repo=infra/models/zephyr-lite; kernel=cpu_fallback_packv1

sofia: note: q6 artifacts still use detok-pack-v1; we've updated fp16/q8 packs to detok-pack-v2 which preserves bidi marks on short spans. try swapping detok and re-run.
harper: uploaded logs s3://redwood-triage/3723456789/zephyr-q6-logs.tar.gz and opened RI-1999. mitigation: pin zephyr-lite-fp16 for multiorient locales and pause q6 canaries.
infra-bot: Canary hold applied: zephyr-lite q6 auto-promote disabled in us-west-2 (reason: locale detok regression). Rollback trigger: BLEU delta >4 or user error spike >2/min.
munir: plan: (1) rebuild q6 with detok-pack-v2 and rerun suite; (2) if still repro, bisect cpu_fallback_packv1 detok branches; (3) add unit test for bracket attachment+numeric orientation to multiorient_smoke.
